001package org.openstreetmap.josm.plugins.websitewizard;
002
003import org.openstreetmap.josm.gui.dialogs.ToggleDialog;
004import org.openstreetmap.josm.gui.MainApplication;
005import org.openstreetmap.josm.data.osm.OsmPrimitive;
006import org.openstreetmap.josm.spi.preferences.Config;
007
008import javax.swing.*;
009import java.awt.*;
010import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
011import java.net.URI;
012import java.net.URLEncoder;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014
015import org.openstreetmap.josm.command.ChangePropertyCommand;
016import org.openstreetmap.josm.command.Command;
017import org.openstreetmap.josm.command.SequenceCommand;
018import org.openstreetmap.josm.data.UndoRedoHandler;
019import org.openstreetmap.josm.gui.util.GuiHelper;
020import org.openstreetmap.josm.gui.widgets.DisableShortcutsOnFocusGainedTextField;
021
022public class WebsiteWizardDialog extends ToggleDialog {
023    
024    private final DisableShortcutsOnFocusGainedTextField searchPrefixField;
025    private final DisableShortcutsOnFocusGainedTextField websiteUrlField;
026    private final JButton searchButton;
027    private final JButton setTagButton;
028    private final JLabel statusLabel;
029    
030    public WebsiteWizardDialog() {
031        super("Website Wizard", "websitewizard", "Tool to add website tags to OSM features", null, 135);
032        
033        // Create main panel
034        JPanel mainPanel = new JPanel();
035        mainPanel.setLayout(new GridBagLayout());
036        GridBagConstraints gbc = new GridBagConstraints();
037        gbc.fill = GridBagConstraints.HORIZONTAL;
038        
039        // Search Prefix Label & Field
040        gbc.gridx = 0;
041        gbc.gridy = 0;
042        gbc.weightx = 0;
043        mainPanel.add(new JLabel("Search Prefix:"), gbc);
044        
045        gbc.gridx = 1;
046        gbc.weightx = 1;
047        searchPrefixField = new DisableShortcutsOnFocusGainedTextField(15);
048        searchPrefixField.setToolTipText("City and/or neighborhood");
049        mainPanel.add(searchPrefixField, gbc);
050        
051        // Search Button
052        gbc.gridx = 2;
053        gbc.weightx = 0;
054        searchButton = new JButton("Search");
055        searchButton.addActionListener(new AbstractAction() {
056            @Override
057            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
058                search();
059            }
060        });
061        mainPanel.add(searchButton, gbc);
062        
063        // Website URL Label & Field
064        gbc.gridx = 0;
065        gbc.gridy = 1;
066        gbc.weightx = 0;
067        mainPanel.add(new JLabel("Website URL:"), gbc);
068        
069        gbc.gridx = 1;
070        gbc.weightx = 1;
071        websiteUrlField = new DisableShortcutsOnFocusGainedTextField(15);
072        websiteUrlField.setToolTipText("Paste the website URL here");
073        mainPanel.add(websiteUrlField, gbc);
074        
075        // Set Tag Button
076        gbc.gridx = 2;
077        gbc.weightx = 0;
078        setTagButton = new JButton("Save");
079        setTagButton.addActionListener(new AbstractAction() {
080            @Override
081            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
082                setWebsiteTag();
083            }
084        });
085        mainPanel.add(setTagButton, gbc);
086        
087        // Status Label
088        gbc.gridx = 0;
089        gbc.gridy = 3;
090        gbc.gridwidth = 3;
091        gbc.anchor = GridBagConstraints.CENTER;
092        statusLabel = new JLabel("Ready");
093        statusLabel.setForeground(new Color(0, 100, 0));
094        statusLabel.setHorizontalAlignment(JLabel.CENTER);
095        mainPanel.add(statusLabel, gbc);
096        
097        // Add padding at bottom
098        gbc.gridx = 0;
099        gbc.gridy = 4;
100        gbc.weighty = 1;
101        mainPanel.add(Box.createVerticalGlue(), gbc);
102        
103        createLayout(mainPanel, false, null);
104    }
105    
106    private void search() {
107        String prefix = searchPrefixField.getText().trim();
108        OsmPrimitive selected = getSelectedOsmObject();
109        
110        if (selected == null) {
111            statusLabel.setText("Error: No OSM object selected");
112            statusLabel.setForeground(Color.RED);
113            return;
114        }
115        
116        String name = selected.get("name");
117        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
118            statusLabel.setText("Error: Selected object has no 'name' tag");
119            statusLabel.setForeground(Color.RED);
120            return;
121        }
122        
123        try {
124            boolean startsWithPrefix = name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix.toLowerCase());
125            String searchQuery = startsWithPrefix ? name : prefix + " " + name;
126            String encodedQuery = URLEncoder.encode(searchQuery, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
127            String searchProviderUrlPrefix = Config.getPref().get("websitewizard.search-provider-url-prefix", "https://duckduckgo.com/?q=");
128            String searchUrl = searchProviderUrlPrefix + encodedQuery;
129            
130            Desktop.getDesktop().browse(new URI(searchUrl));
131            statusLabel.setText("Searched for: " + searchQuery);
132            statusLabel.setForeground(new Color(0, 100, 0));
133        } catch (Exception e) {
134            statusLabel.setText("Error: " + e.getMessage());
135            statusLabel.setForeground(Color.RED);
136        }
137    }
138    
139    private void setWebsiteTag() {
140        final String url = websiteUrlField.getText().trim();
141        OsmPrimitive selected = getSelectedOsmObject();
142        
143        if (selected == null) {
144            statusLabel.setText("Error: No OSM object selected");
145            statusLabel.setForeground(Color.RED);
146            return;
147        }
148        
149        if (url.isEmpty()) {
150            statusLabel.setText("Error: No URL entered");
151            statusLabel.setForeground(Color.RED);
152            return;
153        }
154
155        // Execute tag injection reliably inside the Event Dispatch Thread (EDT)
156        GuiHelper.runInEDT(() -> {
157            try {
158                ChangePropertyCommand command = new ChangePropertyCommand(selected, "website", url);
159                UndoRedoHandler.getInstance().add(command);
160
161                statusLabel.setText("Set website: " + url);
162                statusLabel.setForeground(new Color(0, 100, 0));
163                websiteUrlField.setText("");
164            } catch (Exception e) {
165                statusLabel.setText("Error: " + e.getMessage());
166                statusLabel.setForeground(Color.RED);
167            }
168        });
169    }
170    
171    private OsmPrimitive getSelectedOsmObject() {
172        var selection = MainApplication.getLayerManager().getEditLayer();
173        if (selection == null) return null;
174        
175        var selected = selection.data.getSelected();
176        if (selected.isEmpty()) return null;
177        
178        return selected.iterator().next();
179    }
180}
